CFML Language Reference: Functions

SpanExcluding

Returns characters from the beginning of a string until it reaches any character in a given set.

Category

String functions

Syntax

SpanExcluding(string, set)

Parameters

string
The string to examine.
set
A string of characters. Each character on its own stops the span.

Returns

The leading characters that are not in the set; the whole string if none of them occurs.

Usage

A quick way to take the first word of a sentence (SpanExcluding(Text, " ")) or the part of an e-mail address before the @. SpanIncluding is its mirror image.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Text = "Hello, world. Goodbye, Y2K bug!">
<CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<LI>Up to the first comma: #SpanExcluding(Text, ",")#
<LI>Up to the first punctuation: #SpanExcluding(Text, ",.!?")#
<LI>User part of webmaster@localhost: #SpanExcluding("webmaster@localhost", "@")#
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

SpanIncluding, FindOneOf, GetToken, ListFirst
